semiconductor_relevance: High — Atotech specializes in advanced surface finishing and plating technologies that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Atotech Taiwan Ltd, a brand of MKS Instruments, develops advanced process and manufacturing technologies for surface modification, including electroless and electrolytic plating. Their comprehensive portfolio includes chemicals, equipment, and services tailored for high-tech applications in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Atotech has a presence in Taiwan, focusing on providing advanced manufacturing technologies and support to local semiconductor manufacturers.
